title: Fever-like pattern check
trigger_patterns: the engine flags the strain_infection_like syndrome (kb/syndromes.json)
engine level is watch or higher and temperature plus resting heart rate moved together
the Decision Card says the pattern is worth checking

steps.text: Stop your current task and sit down. Ask a crew mate to stay nearby.
steps.source: TETHER demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Re-measure heart rate and temperature with the same device you used this morning.
Write both readings and the time into the health log.
steps.source: TETHER demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Ask a crew mate to check your skin colour, your breathing and how alert you seem.
steps.source: TETHER demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Drink some water if you have not drunk in the last hour.
steps.source: TETHER demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: If the card level is act or escalate, open the onboard medical protocol for fever and follow it.
steps.source: onboard medical protocol - no drug doses are shown in TETHER

steps.text: Send the card's ground_message to Earth. Your screen shows the current light delay.
steps.source: TETHER demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Repeat both measurements in 60 minutes and compare with your own normal band.
Escalate now if: confusion, trouble breathing, fainting, or a second crew member shows the same pattern.
steps.source: TETHER demo wording - not a NASA procedure
